title: Saving the gym look from an older open screen quietly undoes a newer look saved elsewhere
what: The Branding screen reads the gym's look once when it opens and never again. Save then sends the whole look (colour, background, logo, heading) with no check that it is still the latest. If the owner (or a second owner login) changed the logo on another computer or phone in the meantime, pressing Save on the older screen puts the old logo and colours back for every member, with no warning.
expected: Save notices that the look changed since the screen opened and asks before replacing it, or only sends the parts the owner changed here.
how_often: rarely: only with two screens open
fix_line: Send the time of the look the screen started from and refuse or ask when the saved look is newer

title: Running the first branding database step again would reset one real gym's chosen look
what: The first branding database step says it is safe to run again, but each run sets RAM'S FITNESS CLUB's colour, background and heading style back to the values written in the step. Any colours that gym's owner picked later in the admin app would be replaced without notice.
expected: A step that is meant to be safe to re-run only fills in a look when the gym has none yet.
how_often: only if that step is ever run again
fix_line: Only set that gym's look when its brand time is empty

evidence: data:Crispy Curves gyms row has logo only, no colour, heading normal, saved 14 Nov 2026 (11:42 India time), matching what Branding would show

items.reason: the Saved date beside Branding uses the computer's time zone, the same fault already logged for other panel dates
no import or undo-import in branding, gym page editor or the shell
no AI in this area: the logo colour and logo background removal are worked out on the owner's computer
no AI answers in this area
nothing is sent to an AI company from this area; the only network calls are the logo upload and reading it back
no paired device here; the member phone's handling of the saved look was traced in code
